quote: The pistachio green interior is so calming. I came for the Spanish Latte and stayed for the tiramisu. Best quiet study spot in Wangsa Maju.
name: Aisyah R.

quote: Finally a cafe that actually looks like its Instagram photos. The matcha strawberry was beautiful and the rattan chairs are super comfy.
name: Nina L.

quote: Run by genuinely friendly young owners who care about their coffee. The Spanish Latte is the smoothest I've had in KL. Closed Mondays though — learned that the hard way!
name: Daniel T.
